title: RepoAssure AI IDE Repair Workflow MCP Convergence Decision and Contract v0.1
objective: Produce an ADR and implementation-ready contract for AI IDE repair workflow MCP convergence by mapping the installed CLI repair capabilities to candidate MCP tools, resources, or prompts; define tool schemas, annotations, compatibility, redaction, error handling, maintainer review, verification, and no-write boundaries without changing the existing eight-tool registry.
acceptance: Produce an accepted or explicitly deferred ADR decision before any MCP registry expansion is proposed.
Map installed CLI handoff, execute, patch-plan, and evidence-package capabilities against the existing generate_repair_plan MCP tool without duplicating domain logic.
Define candidate MCP tool, resource, or prompt boundaries with exact input/output schemas, annotations, error behavior, redaction, idempotency, and open-world expectations.
Define backward compatibility for the existing eight-tool registry and a contract-test matrix for any later implementation.
Preserve maintainer review, validation-only, no target repo write, and no automatic patch application boundaries.
Cascade the decision and contract through canonical docs, testing and acceptance strategy, logs, and Autopilot state without implementing the registry change.
